verdict.rationale: LobeChat's own documentation offers real choices about where data lives: chat data is stored locally on the client by default with optional cloud sync, and the product can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, which the docs say gives "complete control over your data." There is no evidence of region or residency selection for the hosted cloud service, so residency control depends on self-hosting or local-only use. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted cloud, documented data-location guarantees for cloud sync, independent corroboration.
